design: Tier 1, no migration, no Hub-restart hazard (adapter only). The check runs in run_turn after agent selection (and its deselect), before the posture step and the first prompt, on the latest options: options = _options_of(selected) or options, and the 1.0.91 capture shows the agent-selection answer carries the model option. Model: the latest model option's currentValue, else session_response.models.currentModelId. Requested auto or none: no session-start check (currentModelId is the default, not Auto's choice). Reported concrete and different: one copilot.model_substituted with the mid-turn wording, mapper.resolved_model set so the mid-turn path does not repeat it and usage names the model that ran. Reported auto for a concrete request: one copilot.model_substituted saying Copilot chooses the model itself; resolved_model is left for the mid-turn auto_mode_resolved (usage then names the chosen model), which does not report a second time. Effort: the reasoning_effort option's currentValue against control_overrides effort; a difference emits copilot.effort_substituted (info) with requested, resolved and the offered values; no option means no check. Any missing or mistyped field means no report; the check never raises. The offered-model list leaves auto out and drops duplicates.

problem: Copilot accepts any --model and --reasoning-effort and silently replaces what the account's plan does not offer. Recorded at session start: claude-opus-4.7 and grok-4.7 became claude-sonnet-5 on the work PC (1.0.89-1), gpt-5-mini's effort max became medium, and on this machine (1.0.91, an Auto-only plan) grok-4.7 with effort max came back as model auto with no effort option. The Hub's copilot.model_substituted is emitted only from mid-turn session.model_change / auto_mode_resolved / tools_updated events (copilot_acp.py _model), so a substitution Copilot makes at session start is not reported, and the usage sample is attributed to the requested model.

requirements.rationale: A model the operator chose and did not get must be visible from the start of the turn, not only if a mid-turn event happens to name it.
requirements.statement: When a Copilot turn requested a concrete model and the session reports a different one before the first prompt (the latest model config option after agent selection, else models.currentModelId), the turn MUST carry exactly one copilot.model_substituted info diagnostic, posted before the prompt, with facts requested and resolved, naming the models the session offers other than auto; a reported auto MUST be worded as Copilot choosing the model itself.

requirements.rationale: Copilot runs an effort a model does not support as medium, silently.
requirements.statement: When a Copilot turn requested an effort and the session's reasoning_effort config option reports a different current value before the first prompt, the turn MUST carry exactly one copilot.effort_substituted info diagnostic with facts requested, resolved and offered.

requirements.rationale: The meter and the conversation must agree on what ran, and one substitution is one notice.
requirements.statement: A Copilot turn's context-usage samples MUST name the concrete model the session reported at start when it differs from the requested one, and a substitution reported at start MUST NOT be reported again by a mid-turn event of the same turn.

requirements.rationale: Copilot was ready to run the turn; an older CLI (the 1.0.88 captures) has none of these fields.
requirements.statement: The session-start check MUST leave a turn running: it never raises: a requested auto, a matching model or effort, or a session answer missing or mistyping the fields it reads MUST produce no diagnostic and leave the turn as it runs today.
